observations.result: Indonesian landing page displays the 26-unit contents, full-PDF link and source/program navigation. Clicking the nonlinear-pendulum chapter opens CH03.

The chapter displays Indonesian prose, mathematical expressions, figures with descriptions and exercise support. Opening the first problem's solution disclosure reveals its cosine-sum derivation, amplitude and phase discussion. Screenshot visually inspected; no screenshot file was saved. Captured browser error list was empty.

The native reader's English-program link reaches the C120 card. The card lists B70, B80 and C10 prerequisites and the authoritative English source, but explicitly has no program-hosted English reader. This is a hosting/integration gap, not evidence that the English original needs translation.
